title: Demo · Attempt to murder under the BNS, co-accused on bail
story: Accused-1 is charged under BNS 109 and 3(5) for a knife wound in a quarrel over parking on 13.03.2025, an offence punishable with imprisonment for life. He has been in custody since 16.03.2025; the charge sheet came within 90 days, his bail was refused by the Sessions Court, and Co-accused-2, said to have only held the injured, was granted bail by the High Court.

variant.offence: BNS 109 with 3(5), attempt to murder (life imprisonment where hurt is caused), offence after 1 July 2024
variant.custody: default bail closed (charge sheet on day 81 of 90); BNSS s.479 does not apply to an offence punishable with life
variant.record: complete file, eleven born-digital documents including the medico-legal report
variant.parity: Co-accused-2 granted bail with a lesser role; first-time offender; earlier bail application rejected

filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant has been in custody for 608 days without any earlier bail application, and the trial has already commenced, yet no evidence is offered to demonstrate that he will not abscond or tamper with evidence if released.

filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant is charged under BNS 109, which is non-bailable with a maximum punishment of death, indicating the gravity of the offence.

filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant has been in custody for 608 days with no earlier bail application on record, suggesting a pattern of remaining in custody rather than absconding, yet the prosecution may still argue flight risk based on the nature of the charge.
